examples.label: Delivery method chooser in a checkout form
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" for={%{}} id="checkout-delivery-form" class="max-w-md rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-5">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold">Delivery method</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-small" site="Global" class="block mt-1 mb-4 text-gray-500">Estimates apply to orders placed before 2 PM on a business day.</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="delivery-standard" name="delivery" value="standard" space="small" label="Standard — 3 to 5 business days, free" checked />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="delivery-express" name="delivery" value="express" space="small" label="Express — 2 business days, $9.90" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="delivery-overnight" name="delivery" value="overnight" space="small" label="Overnight — next business day, $24.90" />
</.component>

examples.label: Billing cycle picker on a pricing card
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mb-3">Choose your billing cycle <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="billing-monthly" name="billing_cycle" value="monthly" space="small" label="Monthly — $19 per editor" checked /> <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="billing-yearly" name="billing_cycle" value="yearly" space="small" label="Yearly — $190 per editor, two months free" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-small" site="Global" class="block mt-3 text-gray-500">Switch or cancel at any time from your workspace settings.

examples.label: Support ticket priority with a validation error
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mb-3">How urgent is this request? <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="priority-low" name="priority" value="low" color="success" space="small" label="Low — a question, no deadline" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="priority-medium" name="priority" value="medium" color="warning" space="small" label="Medium — a feature is misbehaving" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="priority-high" name="priority" value="high" color="danger" space="small" label="High — the site is down for visitors" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-error" site="Global">Pick a priority so we can route your ticket.
